parameters.name: OnScreenKeyboard
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the options used to configure the on-screen keyboard.

parameters.summary: If true, non-labelable controls can automatically render the aria-labelledby attribute from the label component inside the same Field or Fields.

parameters.name: UseAutoAriaDescribedByAttribute
parameters.summary: If true, input components can automatically render the aria-describedby attribute from the current FieldHelp and validation message elements.

parameters.name: UseAutoAriaInvalidAttribute
parameters.summary: If true, input components can automatically render the aria-invalid attribute from the current validation status.

parameters.name: UseAutoAriaRequiredAttribute
parameters.summary: If true, input components can automatically render the aria-required attribute for required fields.

parameters.name: UseLabelForAttribute
parameters.summary: If true, FieldLabel can automatically render the for attribute for inputs registered in the same Field.

parameters.name: UseValidationOnBlur
parameters.summary: If true, input components wrapped in Validation can trigger validation when they lose focus, even when the value has not changed.

methods.name: ClosePane

methods.name: GetState
methods.summary: Returns the current mutable docking state.

methods.name: IsPaneOpen

methods.name: LoadState

methods.name: OpenPane

methods.name: Refresh

methods.name: ResetState

methods.name: ShowPane

methods.summary: Notifies the chart that it should remove the plugin. Freeing the reference.

methods.name: PopData
methods.summary: Removes the newest data point from the specified dataset.

methods.name: PopLabel
methods.summary: Removes the newest label.

methods.name: RemoveDataSet
methods.summary: Removed the dataset at the specified index.

methods.name: Resize
methods.summary: Manually resize the canvas element. This is run each time the canvas container is resized,      but you can call this method manually if you change the size of the canvas nodes container element.      Should also be called when updating the aspect ratio.

methods.name: SetData
methods.summary: Sets the new data point(s) to the specified dataset.

methods.name: SetOptionsObject
methods.summary: Sets the chart's OptionsObject manually. Must call Update after manging this call. If the options changes AspectRatio must also call Resize after Update.

methods.name: SetOptions
methods.summary: Sets the chart's options manually. Must call Update after making this call.  If the options changes AspectRatio must also call Resize after Update.

methods.name: ShiftData
methods.summary: Removes the oldest data point from the specified dataset.

methods.name: ShiftLabel
methods.summary: Removes the oldest label.

methods.name: Update
methods.summary: Update and redraw the chart.

events.name: GestureMoved
events.summary: Raised while an active gesture moves. The callback is throttled by MoveThrottleInterval.

events.name: GestureStarted
events.summary: Raised when a gesture starts.

events.name: LongPressed
events.summary: Raised when an active gesture is held long enough to be recognized as a long press.

events.name: Swiped
events.summary: Raised when a completed gesture is recognized as a swipe.

events.name: Tapped
events.summary: Raised when a completed gesture is recognized as a tap.

methods.name: OnGestureEnded
methods.summary: Handles a gesture end notification from the browser.

methods.name: OnGestureMoved

methods.name: OnLongPressed

methods.name: OnSwiped

components.summary:
$"""
       A wrapper that represents a row in a css grid.
       """

parameters.name: Attributes
parameters.summary: Captures unmatched HTML attributes for customization.
parameters.remarks: These attributes are applied directly to the component's root HTML element.

parameters.name: Background
parameters.summary: Sets the background color of the component.

parameters.name: Border
parameters.summary: Configures the border properties of the component.

parameters.name: Casing
parameters.summary: Specifies the text casing transformation (e.g., uppercase, lowercase).

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.summary: Specifies the content to be rendered inside this Grid.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.summary: Custom CSS class name to apply to the component.

parameters.name: Clearfix
parameters.summary: Determines whether to apply clearfix to manage floating children.

parameters.name: Columns
parameters.summary: Specifies the number of columns to show in a grid.

parameters.name: Display
parameters.summary: Specifies the display behavior (e.g., block, inline, flex) of the component.

parameters.name: ElementId
parameters.summary: Specifies the unique id of the element.
parameters.remarks: Note that this ID is not defined for the component but instead for the underlined element that it represents.     eg: for the TextInput the ID will be set on the input element.

parameters.name: Flex
parameters.summary: Configures the flexbox properties of the component.

parameters.name: Float
parameters.summary: Specifies how an element should float within its containing block.

parameters.name: Gap
parameters.summary: Configures the gap spacing between child elements of the component.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.summary: Specifies the height of the component using responsive sizing utilities.

parameters.name: Margin
parameters.summary: Configures the margin spacing for the component.

parameters.name: ObjectFit
parameters.summary: Configures the object-fit property, which determines how content is resized within its container.

parameters.name: Overflow
parameters.summary: Configures the overflow behavior when content exceeds the component's bounds.

parameters.name: Padding
parameters.summary: Configures the padding spacing for the component.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.summary: Specifies the positioning method for the component (static, relative, absolute, etc.).

parameters.name: Rows
parameters.summary: Specifies the number of rows to show in a grid.

parameters.name: Shadow
parameters.summary: Configures the shadow effect of the component.

parameters.name: Style
parameters.summary: Custom inline styles to apply to the component.

parameters.name: TextAlignment
parameters.summary: Configures the horizontal alignment of text within the component.

parameters.name: TextColor
parameters.summary: Specifies the text color of the component.

parameters.name: TextDecoration
parameters.summary: Specifies the text decoration style (e.g., underline, none) for the component.

parameters.name: TextOverflow
parameters.summary: Configures how text behaves when it overflows its container.

parameters.name: TextSize
parameters.summary: Sets the font size of the text in the component.

parameters.name: TextTransform
parameters.summary: Configures the text transformation (e.g., capitalize, none) of the component.

parameters.name: TextWeight
parameters.summary: Specifies the font weight of text in the component (e.g., bold, normal).

parameters.name: UtilityTarget
parameters.summary: Specifies the default target where utility classes and styles are applied when no per-utility target is set.

parameters.name: VerticalAlignment
parameters.summary: Specifies the vertical alignment of inline or table-cell elements.

parameters.name: Visibility
parameters.summary: Controls the visibility of an element without altering its layout.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.summary: Specifies the width of the component using responsive sizing utilities.

methods.name: PopData

methods.name: PopLabel
methods.summary: Removes the newest label.

methods.name: RemoveDataSet
methods.summary: Removed the dataset at the specified index.

methods.name: Resize

methods.name: SetData
methods.summary: Sets the new data point(s) to the specified dataset.

methods.name: SetOptionsObject
methods.summary: Sets the chart's OptionsObject manually. Must call Update after manging this call. If the options changes AspectRatio must also call Resize after Update.

methods.name: SetOptions

methods.name: ShiftData
methods.summary: Removes the oldest data point from the specified dataset.

methods.name: ShiftLabel
methods.summary: Removes the oldest label.

methods.name: Update
methods.summary: Update and redraw the chart.

$"""
       Component for acts as a wrapper around the EasyMDE, a markdown editor.
       """

parameters.name: AriaDescribedBy
parameters.summary: Specifies the aria-describedby attribute value.
parameters.remarks: When set, this value is rendered as-is and overrides help and validation message ids generated by Field and Validation.

parameters.name: AriaInvalid
parameters.summary: Specifies the aria-invalid attribute value.
parameters.remarks: When set, this value is rendered as-is and overrides the validation-derived aria-invalid state.

parameters.name: AriaLabelledBy
parameters.summary: Specifies the aria-labelledby attribute value.
parameters.remarks: When set, this value is rendered as-is. Some non-labelable controls can otherwise derive it automatically from a parent FieldLabel or FieldsLabel.

parameters.name: AriaRequired
parameters.summary: Specifies the aria-required attribute value.
parameters.remarks: When set, this value overrides the required-field state resolved from the parent Validation.

parameters.name: Attributes
parameters.summary: Captures unmatched HTML attributes for customization.
parameters.remarks: These attributes are applied directly to the component's root HTML element.

parameters.name: AutoDownloadFontAwesome
parameters.summary: If set to true, force downloads Font Awesome (used for icons). If set to false, prevents downloading.

parameters.name: AutoRefresh
parameters.summary: Useful, when initializing the editor in a hidden DOM node. If set to { delay: 300 },     it will check every 300 ms if the editor is visible and if positive, call CodeMirror's refresh().

parameters.name: Autofocus
parameters.summary: Set's the focus to the component after the rendering is done.

parameters.name: Autosave
parameters.summary: Saves the text that's being written and will load it back in the future.     It will forget the text when the form it's contained in is submitted.

parameters.name: Background
parameters.summary: Sets the background color of the component.

parameters.name: BlockStyles
parameters.summary: Customize how certain buttons that style blocks of text behave.

parameters.name: Border
parameters.summary: Configures the border properties of the component.

parameters.name: Casing
parameters.summary: Specifies the text casing transformation (e.g., uppercase, lowercase).

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.summary: Specifies the content to be rendered inside this Markdown.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.summary: Custom CSS class name to apply to the component.

parameters.name: Classes
parameters.summary: Custom CSS class names for component elements.

parameters.name: Clearfix
parameters.summary: Determines whether to apply clearfix to manage floating children.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.summary: rtl or ltr. Changes text direction to support right-to-left languages. Defaults to ltr.

parameters.name: DisableProgressReport
parameters.summary:
Determines whether report progress should be disabled. By enabling this setting, ImageUploadProgressed and ImageUploadWritten callbacks won't be called. Internal file progress won't be tracked.

This setting can speed up file transfer considerably.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.summary: Add the disabled boolean attribute on an input to prevent user interactions and make it appear lighter.

parameters.name: Display
parameters.summary: Specifies the display behavior (e.g., block, inline, flex) of the component.

parameters.name: ElementId
parameters.summary: Specifies the unique id of the element.
parameters.remarks: Note that this ID is not defined for the component but instead for the underlined element that it represents.     eg: for the TextInput the ID will be set on the input element.

parameters.name: ErrorMessages
parameters.summary: Errors displayed to the user, using the errorCallback option, where #image_name#, #image_size#     and #image_max_size# will replaced by their respective values, that can be used for customization     or internationalization.

parameters.name: Feedback
parameters.summary: Placeholder for validation messages.

parameters.name: Flex
parameters.summary: Configures the flexbox properties of the component.

parameters.name: Float
parameters.summary: Specifies how an element should float within its containing block.

parameters.name: ForceSync
parameters.summary: If set to true, force text changes made in EasyMDE to be immediately stored in original text area.     Defaults to false.

parameters.name: Gap
parameters.summary: Configures the gap spacing between child elements of the component.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.summary: Specifies the height of the component using responsive sizing utilities.

parameters.name: HideIcons
parameters.summary: An array of icon names to hide. Can be used to hide specific icons shown by default without     completely customizing the toolbar.

parameters.name: ImageAccept
parameters.summary: A comma-separated list of mime-types used to check image type before upload (note: never trust client, always     check file types at server-side). Defaults to image/png, image/jpeg.

parameters.name: ImageCSRFToken
parameters.summary: CSRF token to include with AJAX call to upload image. For instance used with Django backend.

parameters.name: ImageMaxSize
parameters.summary: Maximum image size in bytes, checked before upload (note: never trust client, always check image     size at server-side). Defaults to 1024*1024*2 (2Mb).

parameters.name: ImagePathAbsolute
parameters.summary: If set to true, will treat imageUrl from imageUploadFunction and filePath returned from imageUploadEndpoint as     an absolute rather than relative path, i.e. not prepend window.location.origin to it.

parameters.name: ImageTexts
parameters.summary: Texts displayed to the user (mainly on the status bar) for the import image feature, where     #image_name#, #image_size# and #image_max_size# will replaced by their respective values, that     can be used for customization or internationalization.

parameters.name: ImageUploadEndpoint
parameters.summary: The endpoint where the images data will be sent, via an asynchronous POST request. The server is supposed to     save this image, and return a json response.

parameters.name: IndentWithTabs
parameters.summary: If set to false, indent using spaces instead of tabs. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: InputStyle
parameters.summary: textarea or contenteditable.     Defaults to textarea for desktop and contenteditable for mobile.     contenteditable option is necessary to enable nativeSpellcheck.

parameters.name: InsertTexts
parameters.summary: Customize how certain buttons that insert text behave. Takes an array with two elements.     The first element will be the text inserted before the cursor or highlight, and the second     element will be inserted after.     For example, this is the default link value: [\"[\", \"](http://)\"].

parameters.name: LineNumbers
parameters.summary: If set to true, enables line numbers in the editor.

parameters.name: LineWrapping
parameters.summary: If set to false, disable line wrapping. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: Margin
parameters.summary: Configures the margin spacing for the component.

parameters.name: MaxHeight
parameters.summary: Sets fixed height for the composition area. minHeight option will be ignored.     Should be a string containing a valid CSS value like \"500px\". Defaults to undefined.

parameters.name: MaxUploadImageChunkSize
parameters.summary: Specifies the max chunk size when uploading the file. Take note that if you're using IFileEntry,CancellationToken) you're provided with a stream and should configure the chunk size when handling with the stream.
parameters.remarks: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/blazor/javascript-interoperability/call-dotnet-from-javascript?view=aspnetcore-6.0#stream-from-javascript-to-net

parameters.name: MinHeight
parameters.summary: Sets the minimum height for the composition area, before it starts auto-growing.     Should be a string containing a valid CSS value like \"500px\". Defaults to \"300px\".

parameters.name: NativeSpellcheck
parameters.summary: If set to false, disable native spell checker. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: ObjectFit
parameters.summary: Configures the object-fit property, which determines how content is resized within its container.

parameters.name: OnScreenKeyboard
parameters.summary: Enables the on-screen keyboard for this input component. When not explicitly set, the global accessibility option is used.

parameters.name: OnScreenKeyboardEnterKeyBehavior
parameters.summary: Specifies how the on-screen keyboard enter key should behave for this input component.

parameters.name: OnScreenKeyboardLayout
parameters.summary: Specifies the on-screen keyboard layout for this input component. When not explicitly set, the global accessibility option is used.

parameters.name: OnScreenKeyboardShowMode
parameters.summary: Gets or sets how the on-screen keyboard is shown for this input.

parameters.name: Overflow
parameters.summary: Configures the overflow behavior when content exceeds the component's bounds.

parameters.name: Padding
parameters.summary: Configures the padding spacing for the component.

parameters.name: ParsingConfig
parameters.summary: Adjust settings for parsing the Markdown during editing (not previewing).

parameters.name: Placeholder
parameters.summary: If set, displays a custom placeholder message.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.summary: Specifies the positioning method for the component (static, relative, absolute, etc.).

parameters.name: PreviewClass
parameters.summary: A space-separated strings that will be applied to the preview screen when activated.     Defaults to \"editor-preview\".

parameters.name: PreviewImagesInEditor
parameters.summary: EasyMDE will show preview of images, false by default,     preview for images will appear only for images on separate lines.

parameters.name: PromptTexts
parameters.summary: Customize the text used to prompt for URLs.

parameters.name: PromptURLs
parameters.summary: If set to true, a JS alert window appears asking for the link or image URL.     Defaults to false.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.summary: Add the readonly boolean attribute on an input to prevent modification of the input’s value.

parameters.name: RenderingConfig
parameters.summary: Adjust settings for parsing the Markdown during previewing (not editing).

parameters.name: ScrollbarStyle
parameters.summary: Chooses a scrollbar implementation.     The default is \"native\", showing native scrollbars.          The core library also provides the \"null\" style, which completely hides the scrollbars.     Addons can implement additional scrollbar models.

parameters.name: SegmentFetchTimeout
parameters.summary: Specifies the Segment Fetch Timeout when uploading the file.

parameters.name: Shadow
parameters.summary: Configures the shadow effect of the component.

parameters.name: Shortcuts
parameters.summary: Keyboard shortcuts associated with this instance. Defaults to the array of shortcuts.

parameters.name: ShowIcons
parameters.summary: An array of icon names to show. Can be used to show specific icons hidden by default without     completely customizing the toolbar.

parameters.name: SideBySideFullscreen
parameters.summary: If set to false, allows side-by-side editing without going into fullscreen. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.summary: Sets the size of the input control.

parameters.name: SpellChecker
parameters.summary: If set to false, disable the spell checker. Defaults to true

parameters.name: Status
parameters.summary: If set to empty array, hide the status bar. Defaults to the array of built-in status bar items.     Optionally, you can set an array of status bar items to include, and in what order.

parameters.name: Style
parameters.summary: Custom inline styles to apply to the component.

parameters.name: StyleSelectedText
parameters.summary: If set to false, remove the CodeMirror-selectedtext class from selected lines. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: Styles
parameters.summary: Custom inline styles for component elements.

parameters.name: SyncSideBySidePreviewScroll
parameters.summary: If set to false, disable syncing scroll in side by side mode. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: TabIndex
parameters.summary: If defined, indicates that its element can be focused and can participates in sequential keyboard navigation.

parameters.name: TabSize
parameters.summary: If set, customize the tab size. Defaults to 2.

parameters.name: TextAlignment
parameters.summary: Configures the horizontal alignment of text within the component.

parameters.name: TextColor
parameters.summary: Specifies the text color of the component.

parameters.name: TextDecoration
parameters.summary: Specifies the text decoration style (e.g., underline, none) for the component.

parameters.name: TextOverflow
parameters.summary: Configures how text behaves when it overflows its container.

parameters.name: TextSize
parameters.summary: Sets the font size of the text in the component.

parameters.name: TextTransform
parameters.summary: Configures the text transformation (e.g., capitalize, none) of the component.

parameters.name: TextWeight
parameters.summary: Specifies the font weight of text in the component (e.g., bold, normal).

parameters.name: Theme
parameters.summary: Override the theme. Defaults to easymde.

parameters.name: Toolbar
parameters.summary: [Optional] Gets or sets the content of the toolbar.

parameters.name: ToolbarButtonClassPrefix
parameters.summary: Adds a prefix to the toolbar button classes when set. For example, a value of `\"mde\"` results in `\"mde-bold\"` for the Bold button.

parameters.name: ToolbarTips
parameters.summary: If set to false, disable toolbar button tips. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: UnorderedListStyle
parameters.summary: can be *, - or +. Defaults to *.

parameters.name: UploadImage
parameters.summary: If set to true, enables the image upload functionality, which can be triggered by drag-drop,     copy-paste and through the browse-file window (opened when the user click on the upload-image icon).     Defaults to true.

parameters.name: UtilityTarget

parameters.name: VerticalAlignment

parameters.name: Visibility

parameters.name: Width
parameters.summary: Specifies the width of the component using responsive sizing utilities.

$"""
       The SignaturePad component allows for the creation of a digital signature pad, which allows users to draw signatures using a mouse, touchpad, or stylus. This component can be used in various applications such as electronic forms, contracts, and agreements.
       """

parameters.name: AriaLabelledBy
parameters.summary: Specifies the aria-labelledby attribute value.

parameters.name: Attributes
parameters.summary: Captures unmatched HTML attributes for customization.
parameters.remarks: These attributes are applied directly to the component's root HTML element.

parameters.name: Background
parameters.summary: Sets the background color of the component.

parameters.name: BackgroundColor
parameters.summary: The color used to define the background color of the signature pad. Can be any color format; including HEX, or rgb.

parameters.name: Border
parameters.summary: Configures the border properties of the component.

parameters.name: CanvasHeight
parameters.summary: Specifies the height, in pixels, of the underline canvas element.

parameters.name: CanvasWidth
parameters.summary: Specifies the width, in pixels, of the underline canvas element.

parameters.name: Casing
parameters.summary: Specifies the text casing transformation (e.g., uppercase, lowercase).

parameters.name: Class
parameters.summary: Custom CSS class name to apply to the component.

parameters.name: Clearfix
parameters.summary: Determines whether to apply clearfix to manage floating children.

parameters.name: Display
parameters.summary: Specifies the display behavior (e.g., block, inline, flex) of the component.

parameters.name: DotSize
parameters.summary: The radius of a single dot. Also the width of the start of a mark.

parameters.name: ElementId
parameters.summary: Specifies the unique id of the element.
parameters.remarks: Note that this ID is not defined for the component but instead for the underlined element that it represents.     eg: for the TextInput the ID will be set on the input element.

parameters.name: Flex
parameters.summary: Configures the flexbox properties of the component.

parameters.name: Float
parameters.summary: Specifies how an element should float within its containing block.

parameters.name: Gap
parameters.summary: Configures the gap spacing between child elements of the component.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.summary: Specifies the height of the component using responsive sizing utilities.

parameters.name: ImageQuality
parameters.summary: The encoder options for image type [png, jpeg] to get from the canvas element. Accepted range is from 0 to 1, where 1 means best quality.

parameters.name: ImageType
parameters.summary: The image type [png, jpeg, svg] to get from the canvas element.

parameters.name: IncludeImageBackgroundColor
parameters.summary: If true, the [svg] image returned from the canvas will include background color defined by the BackgroundColor parameter.

parameters.name: Margin
parameters.summary: Configures the margin spacing for the component.

parameters.name: MaxLineWidth
parameters.summary: The maximum width of a line.

parameters.name: MinDistance
parameters.summary: Add the next point only if the previous one is farther than 'n' pixels. Defaults to 5.

parameters.name: MinLineWidth
parameters.summary: The minimum width of a line.

parameters.name: ObjectFit
parameters.summary: Configures the object-fit property, which determines how content is resized within its container.

parameters.name: Overflow
parameters.summary: Configures the overflow behavior when content exceeds the component's bounds.

parameters.name: Padding
parameters.summary: Configures the padding spacing for the component.

parameters.name: PenColor
parameters.summary: The color used to define the lines color of the signature pad. Can be any color format; including HEX, or rgb.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.summary: Specifies the positioning method for the component (static, relative, absolute, etc.).

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.summary: If true, prevents the user interaction.

parameters.name: Shadow
parameters.summary: Configures the shadow effect of the component.

parameters.name: Style
parameters.summary: Custom inline styles to apply to the component.

parameters.name: TabIndex
parameters.summary: If defined, indicates that its element can be focused and can participates in sequential keyboard navigation.

parameters.name: TextAlignment
parameters.summary: Configures the horizontal alignment of text within the component.

parameters.name: TextColor
parameters.summary: Specifies the text color of the component.

parameters.name: TextDecoration
parameters.summary: Specifies the text decoration style (e.g., underline, none) for the component.

parameters.name: TextOverflow
parameters.summary: Configures how text behaves when it overflows its container.

parameters.name: TextSize
parameters.summary: Sets the font size of the text in the component.

parameters.name: TextTransform
parameters.summary: Configures the text transformation (e.g., capitalize, none) of the component.

parameters.name: TextWeight
parameters.summary: Specifies the font weight of text in the component (e.g., bold, normal).

parameters.name: Throttle
parameters.summary: The time in milliseconds to throttle drawing. Set to 0 to turn off throttling.

parameters.name: UtilityTarget
parameters.summary: Specifies the default target where utility classes and styles are applied when no per-utility target is set.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.summary: Gets or sets value for the signature pad.

parameters.name: VelocityFilterWeight
parameters.summary: The weight used to modify new velocity based on the previous velocity.

parameters.name: VerticalAlignment
parameters.summary: Specifies the vertical alignment of inline or table-cell elements.

parameters.name: Visibility
parameters.summary: Controls the visibility of an element without altering its layout.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.summary: Specifies the width of the component using responsive sizing utilities.

events.name: BeginStroke
events.summary: Defines the event that is triggered when a new stroke begins on the signature pad. The event provides information about the starting point of the stroke.

events.name: EndStroke
events.summary: Defines the event that is triggered when a stroke ends on the signature pad. The event provides the signature pad's current image data as a Data URL.

events.name: ValueChanged
events.summary: Defines the event that is triggered when the signature pad value changes. The event provides the new signature as a byte array.

methods.name: Clear
methods.summary: Clears the content of a signature canvas.

methods.name: GetDataUrl
methods.summary: Gets the data url based on the image type and the data array.

methods.name: Undo
methods.summary: Undos the last stroke if there is any.

parameters.summary: Configures the margin spacing for the component.

parameters.name: Narrow
parameters.summary: Makes the table more compact by cutting cell padding in half.

parameters.name: ObjectFit
parameters.summary: Configures the object-fit property, which determines how content is resized within its container.

parameters.name: Overflow
parameters.summary: Configures the overflow behavior when content exceeds the component's bounds.

events.summary: The drag event is fired every few hundred milliseconds as an element or text selection is being dragged by the user.

events.summary: The DragEnd event is fired when a drag operation is being ended (by releasing a mouse button or hitting the escape key).

events.name: DragEnter

events.name: DragLeave

events.name: DragOver
events.summary: The DragOver event is fired when an element or text selection is being dragged over a valid drop target (every few hundred milliseconds).

events.name: DragStart

events.name: Drop
events.summary: The drop event is fired when an element or text selection is dropped on a valid drop target.

methods.name: ScrollToPixels
methods.summary: If table has FixedHeader enabled, it will scroll position to the provided pixels.

methods.name: ScrollToRow
methods.summary: If table has FixedHeader enabled, it will scroll position to the provided row.

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.summary: Specifies the content to be rendered inside this Validations.

parameters.name: EditContext
parameters.summary: Supplies the edit context explicitly. If using this parameter, do not also supply Model, since the model value will be taken from the EditContext.Model property.

parameters.name: HandlerType
parameters.summary: Specifies the default handler type that will be used by the validation, unless it is overriden by HandlerType property.

parameters.name: MissingFieldsErrorMessage
parameters.summary: Message that will be displayed if any of the validations does not have defined error message.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.summary: Specifies the validation mode for validations inside of this container.

parameters.name: Model
parameters.summary: Specifies the top-level model object for the form. An edit context will be constructed for this model. If using this parameter, do not also supply a value for EditContext.

parameters.name: ValidateOnLoad
parameters.summary: If set to true, and Mode is set to Auto, validation will run automatically on page load.
parameters.remarks: When validation is placed inside of modal dialog, the behavior is a little different. Modals are by definition always loaded and are always present in the DOM so no loading is ever happening again after the page that contains the modal is first initialized. Their visibility is controlled by display: none; To workaround this, the actual \"first load\" for modals can be done by re-initializing Model parameter.

events.name: FailedValidationsChanged
events.summary: Event is fired whenever the failed validation messages change.

events.name: StatusChanged
events.summary: Event is fired whenever there is a change in validation status.

events.name: ValidatedAll
events.summary: Event is fired only after all of the validation are successful.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.summary: Clears all validation statuses.

methods.name: NotifyValidationInitialized
methods.summary: Notifies the validation system that a new validation component has been initialized and adds it to the list of validations if not already present.

methods.name: NotifyValidationRemoved
methods.summary: Notifies the validation system that a validation component is being removed and removes it from the list of validations if present.

methods.name: NotifyValidationStatusChanged
methods.summary: Notifies the validation system that the status of a validation component has changed. This method handles the logic for updating the overall validation status based on the mode (Auto or Manual) and the current validation results.
methods.remarks: In Auto mode, this method triggers the aggregation of validation results and potentially raises a status changed event.     It is designed to minimize the number of status changed events by aggregating validation results.     Special consideration is needed to ensure that the status changed event is raised only once per validation cycle,     even if multiple validations fail.

methods.name: RetriggerValidation
methods.summary: Retriggers validations for the specified model fields.

methods.name: RetriggerValidation
methods.summary: Retriggers validations that match the given FieldIdentifier instances.

methods.name: ValidateAll
methods.summary: Asynchronously runs the validation process for all validations and returns false if any is failed.

       The video component embeds a media player which supports video playback into the document.
       """

parameters.name: Attributes
parameters.summary: Captures unmatched HTML attributes for customization.
parameters.remarks: These attributes are applied directly to the component's root HTML element.

parameters.name: AutoPause
parameters.summary: Determines whether starting this player pauses any other active player.

parameters.name: AutoPlay
parameters.summary: Determines whether playback starts automatically.

parameters.name: AutomaticallyHideControls
parameters.summary: Determines whether the controls hide automatically when the player becomes idle.

parameters.name: AvailableQualities
parameters.summary: Specifies the list of available quality options. Defaults to [4320, 2880, 2160, 1440, 1080, 720, 576, 480, 360, 240].

parameters.name: Background
parameters.summary: Sets the background color of the component.

parameters.name: Border
parameters.summary: Configures the border properties of the component.

parameters.name: Casing
parameters.summary: Specifies the text casing transformation (e.g., uppercase, lowercase).

parameters.summary: Custom CSS class name to apply to the component.

parameters.summary: Determines whether to apply clearfix to manage floating children.

parameters.name: ClickToPlay
parameters.summary: Click (or tap) of the video container will toggle play/pause.

parameters.name: Controls
parameters.summary: Determines whether player controls are visible.

parameters.name: ControlsDelay
parameters.summary: Specifies how long the controls remain visible after the last user interaction, in milliseconds.

parameters.defaultValue: new string[] { VideoControlsType.PlayLarge, VideoControlsType.Play, VideoControlsType.Progress, VideoControlsType.CurrentTime, VideoControlsType.Mute, VideoControlsType.Volume, VideoControlsType.Captions, VideoControlsType.Settings, VideoControlsType.Pip, VideoControlsType.Airplay, VideoControlsType.Fullscreen }

parameters.summary: If defined the player will go fullscreen when the video is double-clicked.

parameters.summary: Specifies the manual structure of the protection data. If defined, it will override the usage of ProtectionServerUrl and ProtectionHttpRequestHeaders.

parameters.name: ProtectionHttpRequestHeaders
parameters.summary: Specifies the protection token for the http header that is sent to the server.

parameters.name: ProtectionServerCertificateUrl
parameters.summary: Specifies the server certificate url of the DRM protection (currently used only with FairPlay).

parameters.summary: Specifies the server url of the DRM protection.

parameters.summary: Specifies the encoding type used for the DRM protection.

parameters.summary: Force an aspect ratio for all videos. The format is 'w:h' - e.g. '16:9' or '4:3'. If this is not specified     then the default for HTML5 and Vimeo is to use the native resolution of the video. As dimensions are not     available from YouTube via SDK, 16:9 is forced as a sensible default.

events.name: CaptionsDisabled
events.summary: Sent when captions are disabled.

events.name: CaptionsEnabled
events.summary: Sent when captions are enabled.

events.name: ControlsHidden
events.summary: Sent when the controls are hidden.

events.name: ControlsShown
events.summary: Sent when the controls are shown.

events.name: Ended
events.summary: Sent when playback completes. Note: This does not fire if autoplay is true.

events.name: FullScreenEntered
events.summary: Sent when the player enters fullscreen mode (either the proper fullscreen or full-window fallback for older browsers).

events.name: FullScreenExited
events.summary: Sent when the player exits fullscreen mode.

events.name: LanguageChange
events.summary: Sent when the caption language is changed.

events.name: Paused
events.summary: Sent when playback is paused.

events.name: Played
events.summary: Sent when playback of the media starts after having been paused; that is, when playback is resumed after a prior pause event.

events.name: Playing
events.summary: Sent when the media begins to play (either for the first time, after having been paused, or after ending and then restarting).

events.name: Progress
events.summary: Sent periodically to inform interested parties of progress downloading the media. Information about the current amount of the media that has been downloaded is available in the media element's buffered attribute.

events.name: QualityChanged
events.summary:
The quality of playback has changed.

If the quality argument is null it is considered that a default quality value was selected.

events.name: RateChange
events.summary: Sent when the playback speed changes.

events.name: Ready
events.summary: Triggered when the instance is ready for API calls.

events.name: Seeked
events.summary: Sent when a seek operation completes.

events.name: Seeking
events.summary: Sent when a seek operation begins.

events.name: TimeUpdate
events.summary: The time indicated by the element's currentTime attribute has changed.

events.name: VolumeChange
events.summary: Sent when the audio volume changes (both when the volume is set and when the muted state is changed).

methods.summary: Adds a new text track to the list of tracks.

methods.name: Airplay
methods.summary: Trigger the airplay dialog on supported devices.

methods.name: ClearTextTracks
methods.summary: Clear all the text tracks.

methods.name: DecreaseVolume
methods.summary: Decrease volume by the specified step. If no parameter is passed, the default step will be used.

methods.name: EnterFullscreen
methods.summary: Enter fullscreen. If fullscreen is not supported, a fallback \"full window/viewport\" is used instead.

methods.name: ExitFullscreen
methods.summary: Exit fullscreen.

methods.name: Forward
methods.summary: Fast forward by the specified seek time. If no parameter is passed, the default seek time will be used.

methods.name: HideTextTrack
methods.summary: Hide the track from the list of tracks.

methods.name: IncreaseVolume
methods.summary: Increase volume by the specified step. If no parameter is passed, the default step will be used.

methods.name: Pause
methods.summary: Pause playback.

methods.name: Play
methods.summary: Start playback.

methods.name: Restart
methods.summary: Restart playback.

methods.name: Rewind
methods.summary: Rewind playback by the specified seek time.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.summary: Dispatch an event to change the media playback rate.

methods.name: ShowTextTrack
methods.summary: Show the track from the list of tracks.

methods.name: Stop
methods.summary: Stop playback and reset to start.

methods.name: ToggleCaptions
methods.summary: Toggle captions display.

methods.name: ToggleControls
methods.summary: Toggle the controls (video only). Takes optional truthy value to force it on/off.

methods.name: ToggleFullscreen
methods.summary: Toggle fullscreen.

methods.name: TogglePlay
methods.summary: Toggle playback, if no parameters are passed, it will toggle based on current status.

methods.name: UpdateSource
methods.summary: Updates the media source.

components.summary:
$"""
       Represents JavaScript options for initializing a video player component.
       """

parameters.name: AspectRatio
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the aspect ratio of the video.

parameters.name: AutoPause
parameters.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the video should automatically pause when not in view.

parameters.name: AutoPlay
parameters.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the video should start playing automatically.

parameters.name: AutomaticallyHideControls
parameters.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether controls are automatically hidden.

parameters.name: AvailableQualities
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the available quality options for the video.

parameters.name: ClickToPlay
parameters.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether clicking on the video toggles play/pause.

parameters.name: Controls
parameters.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether video controls are displayed.

parameters.name: ControlsDelay
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the delay in seconds before controls are shown.

parameters.name: ControlsList
parameters.summary: Gets or sets a list of controls to be displayed or hidden.

parameters.name: CurrentTime
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the current playback time of the video in seconds.

parameters.name: DefaultQuality
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the default quality options for the video.

parameters.name: DisableContextMenu
parameters.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the context menu is disabled.

parameters.name: DoubleClickToFullscreen
parameters.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether double-clicking toggles fullscreen mode.

parameters.name: InvertTime
parameters.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the time is displayed in reverse countdown format.

parameters.name: Muted
parameters.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the video is muted.

parameters.name: Poster
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the poster image URL displayed before the video starts.

parameters.name: Protection
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the video protection options for DRM or other access control mechanisms.

parameters.name: ResetOnEnd
parameters.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the video resets to the beginning when it ends.

parameters.name: SeekTime
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the time to skip when seeking forward or backward, in seconds.

parameters.name: SettingsList
parameters.summary: Gets or sets a list of video settings types available in the player.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the source configuration for the video.

parameters.name: StreamingLibrary
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the streaming library to use for video playback.

parameters.name: Thumbnails
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the thumbnail images for video navigation.

parameters.name: Volume
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the volume level of the video, between 0 and 1.

components.summary:
$"""
       Represents video protection options, including DRM configuration and server details.
       """

parameters.name: Data
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the data object used for video protection, such as license or certificate data.

parameters.name: HttpRequestHeaders
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the HTTP headers used for requests to the protection server.

parameters.name: ServerCertificateUrl
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the URL of the server certificate for protected streams.

parameters.name: ServerUrl
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the URL of the protection server.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the type of video protection.

components.summary:
$"""
       Represents quality options for the video, including resolution height.
       """

parameters.name: Height
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the height of the video resolution.

components.summary:
$"""
       Represents JavaScript options for updating specific settings of a video player component dynamically.
       """

parameters.name: CurrentTime
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the option for updating the current playback time.

parameters.name: ProtectionData
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the option for updating the video protection data.

parameters.name: ProtectionHttpRequestHeaders
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the option for updating HTTP request headers for protection.

parameters.name: ProtectionServerCertificateUrl
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the option for updating the protection server certificate URL.

parameters.name: ProtectionServerUrl
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the option for updating the protection server URL.

parameters.name: ProtectionType
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the option for updating the video protection type.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the option for updating the video source.

parameters.name: Volume
parameters.summary: Gets or sets the option for updating the video volume level.

components.summary: $""" Defines the options for DataGrid virtualize mode. """

parameters.name: DataGridHeight
parameters.summary: Sets the DataGrid height when Virtualize feature is enabled (defaults to 500px).

parameters.name: DataGridMaxHeight
parameters.summary: Sets the DataGrid height when Virtualize feature is enabled (defaults to 500px).

parameters.name: OverscanCount
parameters.summary: Gets or sets a value that determines how many additional items will be rendered     before and after the visible region. This help to reduce the frequency of rendering     during scrolling. However, higher values mean that more elements will be present     in the page.

parameters.name: ScrollRowOnEdit
parameters.summary: If DataGrid goes into DataGridEditMode.Inline or DataGridEditMode.Form, scrolls the row to the top.     Defaults to true.
